comparators.regression_evidence: GitHub Actions builds Windows, Ubuntu, Intel macOS and Apple Silicon, then runs a packaged example; CMake BUILD_TESTS option is commented out, so do not describe this as a broad unit-test suite.
features: kinetic rate expressions and equilibrium expressions represented as DAEs
Lagrangian segment transport with react/advect/mix/release/disperse steps
scope_limits: hydraulic engine is EPANET 2.2; no native pressure-driven water-hammer/transient intrusion solver
junction mixing is assumed complete and instantaneous
storage-node mixing is complete (alternative plug-flow storage schemes are available)
wall species do not exist in storage tanks; tank expressions cover bulk species only
bulk species use mass/volume units; wall species use mass/area; user owns unit conversions
segment cap and dispersion options affect numerical diffusion and require sensitivity testing
qualification_requirements: pin EPANET submodule and exact build options
test reaction ODE/DAE tolerances and segment/time-step convergence
verify bulk/wall exchange and pipe-material surface-area binding
verify tank mixing assumption against target facility
test dispersion on/off and Peclet/segment limits
compare against blind multi-matrix laboratory time series

comparators.language: Python research comparator only; not adopted as production runtime
comparators.method: one-dimensional advection-reactive equations solved with explicit Method of Characteristics plus fourth-order Runge-Kutta

regression_evidence.caveat: tests use fixed Net3 topology and prescribed assertions; they are software regression evidence, not physical reaction-rate transfer validation

scope_limits: hydraulics supplied by EPANET 2.2, not high-frequency water hammer or a native defect-ingress model
mechanistic modules require matrix-specific calibration and blind laboratory validation
MOC/RK4 concentration solver requires timestep and spatial refinement analysis
Python research artefact; no production stack dependency proposed
qualification_requirements: pin exact EPyT package and EPANET 2.2 binaries
reproduce Net1/Net3 with exact network blob and module configuration
run blind multi-water-matrix chemistry and material tests
report parent/product mass recovery and wall/bulk transfer separately

comparators.source: Seyoum and Tanyimboh, Water Resources Management 31, 4485–4503 (2017)
features: pressure-driven hydraulics integrated with multispecies water-quality reactions
multiple simultaneous chemical substances and reaction kinetics
scope_limits: no maintained public source/build/test artefact verified in this snapshot
dynamic water-quality does not establish high-frequency water hammer, cavitation or column-separation support
published model claims require independent reproduction and physical validation
qualification_requirements: obtain executable source and exact revision or reproduce equations independently
pin pressure-driven demand and hydraulic solver configuration
separate pressure-driven network dynamics from sub-second water-hammer wave propagation
compare multi-species concentrations and pressure-deficient scenarios against independent measurements

features: single-species reactions under supported EPANET quality assumptions
scope_limits: not a simultaneous multi-species reactive network
standard mixing and reaction assumptions must be declared
qualification_requirements: use only as a matched baseline for supported single-species cases
do not compare against a multi-species solver on unmatched species count

benchmark_hard_gates: no model output is labelled a laboratory observation
no T0 result authorizes potability or release
